title: StrucText-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Model’s Reasoning Ability in Structure-Rich Text
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the reasoning capabilities of LLMs on structured data formats. While it contains a brief section on ethical concerns, it does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, ethics, or morals; in fact, it explicitly notes that the dataset is composed of nonsensical strings to avoid such issues.
